hints.title: Collatz Step Function
hints.text: Compute the number of steps to reach 1: if even divide by 2, if odd multiply by 3 and add 1.

hints.title: Cache Precomputed Powers
hints.text: Store computed power values for previously visited integers to prevent redundant operations across the range.

hints.title: Sort by Power Value and Original Value
hints.text: Sort all integers from lo to hi primarily by their power value and secondarily by their integer value. Return the kth element.

complexity.time: O((hi - lo) * log(hi - lo) + (hi - lo) * C)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing Collatz sequences repeatedly without caching repeats identical branch paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching intermediate numbers reduces work to visiting each Collatz state once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements Collatz sequence with recurrence caching and secondary integer sorting.
